title: What If Every Beaver Vanished? Wildfires Would Change

scenes.text: What if every beaver vanished? A wildfire study says the damage would show up in flames.
Beavers build dams that turn streams into ponds and wet meadows.
Researchers studied five large wildfires across five western U.S. states using satellite images.
Along streams with beaver dams, plants lost about three times less greenness than in similar areas without beavers.
Dammed valleys stayed green while the land around them burned. The ponds seem to act as fire breaks.
Without beavers, those green refuges would shrink. Their small dams may be quiet firefighters.
